scope: Independent audit of original task contracts and synthetic bookkeeping implementation against the accepted upstream source-review packet. No publisher files were acquired, no source simulation was executed, and no hardware was operated.
design_count_boundary: At most one original paired paper-level design after task/scene acceptance and pair sealing; stages, variants, tests and repeats add zero units.

tests.initial_independent_result: 39 methods; 30 passed and 9 failed before requested runtime fixes. Seven additional export tests and two additional consistency tests were then added.
tests.interpretation: Finite authored bookkeeping and packaging examples only; not a safety certification, scientific validation, signature authentication or complete implementation of every future qualified-service field.

coverage.numerical_branches: B05-B10 and their children remain unexecuted
coverage.per_family_preparation: Design, materials, lattice, filled intermediate and final specimen receipt parents; correct family-specific core assignment; no fabrication recipe.
coverage.controls_and_repeats: Physical control and repeat plans remain authored proposals; no source counts or observations invented.
coverage.profile_rule: Rotator profiles transverse; cloak and concentrator parallel. Profile number-to-orientation scene selectors are explicitly authored.
coverage.custody: P11-P14 success path distinct from failure/stop to P15; release uncertainty retains service custody; release and retrieval separate; incomplete closure preserves open obligation.
coverage.actor_reference_separation: agent_visible.json contains structural actions and no source numerical targets; source outcomes remain reference-only. No deployment sandbox or access-control system is claimed.

upstream_checks.source_access_history: Attributed to upstream; this reviewer does not certify unobserved web-access history or re-audit excluded source media.

issues.title: Cross-specimen object-ID reuse
issues.finding: Fresh receipt IDs allowed a different specimen to reuse a previous preparation object chain.
issues.resolution: Episode-wide preparation object IDs are now checked before mutation.

issues.title: Malformed material-lot collection
issues.finding: A string passed the material_lot_ids iterable check.
issues.resolution: A nonempty list of nonempty strings is now required.

issues.title: Duplicate independent-repeat identity
issues.finding: Two slots could call the same specimen and condition two independent repeats.
issues.resolution: All nontechnical specimen/condition pairs must now be unique; technical repeats retain separate slots.

issues.title: Observation source and numerical-payload leakage
issues.finding: Transient and stability tokens accepted source origins, and transient/steady tokens accepted numerical array extras.
issues.resolution: All three observation stages now require explicit synthetic_metadata_only provenance and restrict keys to their metadata schemas.

issues.title: Camera and dataset parent consistency
issues.finding: A transient token could name an unrelated camera configuration.
issues.resolution: P12 matches the current calibration configuration and is retained; P14 also matches its dataset ID.

issues.title: Out-of-order powered observation bypassed abort route
issues.finding: The failed ordering assertion left P11 active without a failure record.
issues.resolution: Ordering checks now enter the guarded failure path, record the failed attempt and route to P15 while custody stays service-owned.

issues.title: Nonportable archive paths
issues.finding: Drive-qualified and backslash traversal member names were accepted.
issues.resolution: Backslash, colon and control characters are rejected before relative-path checks.

remaining_release_conditions: Accepted scene content must share the exact scene_binding_contract.json bytes.
Generate the exact allowlist, content manifests and reciprocal pair seal after reviewed content is stable.
Inspect the final task ZIP independently, including payload membership, hashes, public-relative paths, no excluded files and no private paths.
Keep final archive audit detached to avoid changing sealed content.
limitations: This package implements no hardware adapter, physical simulation, geometry solver, scientific metric or source reproduction.
Synthetic Boolean receipts cannot establish real calibration, physical safe state, geometry fit, authentic service identity or independent manufacture.
The guard demonstrates selected invariants; it is not the full 20-stage qualified-service implementation.
Passing finite hostile tests does not establish universal resistance to arbitrary adversarial inputs or external state tampering.
The original scene must receive its own geometric/export review; this audit checks the shared task binding only.
content_snapshot_scope: Authored content at task-review acceptance, excluding this report, final status and manifest/seal envelope files. Substantive changes require re-audit.
post_review_updates_verified: P17 station_id now ST_IR_CAL, consistent with its A05/AN_CONTROL scene binding; other stage semantics unchanged.
Held exception documentation now reflects failure/hold-state transitions without changing runtime behavior.
STATUS.json, VERIFICATION.json, README.md and asset_binding_plan.json preserve content-only acceptance and detached final release authority.
Preliminary allowlist names all three independent review files and excludes undeclared source/media files; final archive validation remains pending.
